answer: Grading junk as passing is thus a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. The trellis panel is drawn blind, the grove escrow settles at close, and thread lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 14% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. A 196 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
